children: to Outperform from Neutral, saying improving sales productivity and stronger demand for AI observability could boost the company’s growth.
The bank raised its price target to $75 from $50, implying about 25% upside from stock's Thursday early trading price of $60.

BNP expects Dynatrace’s annual recurring revenue growth, currently around 17%, to move toward 20% as more three-year customer contracts come up for renewal, with most of those renewals expected in the second half of the year.

The bank also sees potential for Arize, an AI observability company Dynatrace acquired, to add 1 to 7 percentage points to organic ARR growth over three years as it is offered to Dynatrace’s existing customers.
BNP said its analysis shows sales productivity has improved over the past four quarters, following a slowdown in sales hiring after a 2024 ramp-up.

The bank now values Dynatrace at 8 times estimated 2027 sales, up from 5 times previously, citing stronger growth prospects. It expects an upcoming analyst day to provide further visibility on the company’s growth outlook.

title: BNP Paribas upgrades Dynatrace on ARR growth
